notes: Appointments blank fix (structural). viewAllAppointments() now calls loadAppointments() before opening the modal — modal never trusts in-memory state. loadAppointments() also moved before showTodayZone() in coldstart so the tile count is correct on first paint. Breaks the repeated pattern of blank appointments after version-gated reloads or any code path that reaches the modal without a prior loadAppointments() call.
